name: Estonian Aviation Academy
summary: Aviation academy next to Tartu Airport; its English pilot degrees credit prior licence training, and the management degree took no 2026/27 intake.
notes: The English pilot degree credits 120 ECTS only from prior training at a certified flight school, so it is not a first-year route for a school leaver.
The 1-year pilot programme is for working pilots with a professional licence; Commercial Aviation Management took no applications for 2026/27.
Its first-year bachelor's for school leavers, such as aircraft piloting and air traffic services, are taught in Estonian.
